feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 16 September 2026 8:45pm
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Sunny intervals and the risk of an isolated shower for much of the day. It will turn cloudy early in the evening as patchy outbreaks of rain develop for a time, ahead of a more persistent and widespread band arriving early in the night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W or NW, backing SW, 10-20, then increasing 20-25 late evening, occasionally increasing 30 early in the night, then veering W overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in precipitation. Hill fog at first and again later.


##Comments##

Strong winds later. Shower risk higher in north during daytime.


##Today##

Sunny intervals and isolated showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

24


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W 20-25, occasionally increasing 30 at times until later, then decreasing 15-20 near end of period.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any showers.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.


##Tomorrow##

Dry start, rain arriving during morning, turning patchy later in afternoon then clearing to isolated showers in evening or at first overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

4-10


##Wind Speed##

24

W


##Wind##

W 15-20, soon backing SW 20-25, occasionally 25 gusts 35 for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers. Hill fog developing.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing.
